title: Truco (トゥルコ)
subtitle: South American / Spanish bluffing trick-taking — raise the stakes

hintReason.leadLow: Lead low to save your strong cards
hintReason.followWin: Play a stronger card to win this baza
hintReason.followDump: Dump a weak card and let this baza go

tutorial.score: Match score. The first player to reach the target score wins.
tutorial.trick: Cards played to the table. The matadores (special cards) are strongest and follow their own ranking.
tutorial.hand: Your hand — click a card to play it.
tutorial.call: Calling Truco raises the stake (Truco → Retruco → Vale Cuatro). The opponent may accept, decline, or re-raise.
tutorial.rankRef: Open "Card strength" to see the unique ranking order, including the matadores.

rankRef.title: Card strength (strongest first)
rankRef.note: The four matadores always rank highest. The plain 1s and 7s exclude the matadores. 8/9/10 are not used.
